gaps.title: Chant du Nord, Op. 96
gaps.edition: Paris: Enoch, 1899 (per Wikipedia list of compositions); listed as 'for Violin and Piano' in IMSLP's List of works by Cécile Chaminade
gaps.note: Two sources agree it is an original violin and piano piece, next in number to the Rondeau Op. 97 (same publisher and year). I found no IMSLP page or scan (so key, duration and level are guesses: minutes 4, level 4) and no recording; confirm the title page before ingesting.
